#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long ar[3], br[3];
    cin >> ar[0] >> ar[1] >> ar[2];
    cin >> br[0] >> br[1] >> br[2];
    
    long long mxWins = 0;
    long long mxLosesOrDraw = 0;
    int idx[6] = {0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2};
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        mxWins += min(ar[idx[i]], br[idx[i+1]]);
        long long mxLose = min(br[idx[i]], ar[idx[i+1]]);
        long long mxDraw = min(br[idx[i]], ar[idx[i]]);
        mxLosesOrDraw += min(br[idx[i]], mxLose + mxDraw);
    }
    
    cout << n - mxLosesOrDraw << " " << mxWins << endl;
    return 0;
}
